candidate_sampling_rule: For sequences with at least budget frames, choose budget evenly spaced zero-based indices from 0 through frame_count-1 using numpy.linspace and round to nearest integer. This is a deterministic dry-run specification, not yet a validated scientific optimum.
short_sequence_policy: Unresolved by design. Do not silently repeat frames, pad, or exclude. Select and justify a fallback before actual model input construction.
